The '''Multi-Corporate Complex''' was the headquarters for around half a dozen [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporations]] who operated on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Security was provided by [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] under contract.
